_comment: SD pre-reduce EWL — the SPEC gate-4 ON arm (docs/SPEC_sd_ewl_prereduce.md §7.4).
(+ trace, which is log-only).  min_arc_epochs stays at the SHIPPING default 10 —
unlike _sdewl_smoke10.json, which drops it to 2 purely to diagnose arc availability
eigen_threads / parallel_max_threads are left at the base's 8 so the ONLY treatment
versus runs/golden_0729/net50_wl1off/ is the SD EWL row fold.  (The first ON attempt
used 6; a thread-count delta would have made the spectrum comparison a two-treatment
test, and the parallelism rulebook's byte-identity guarantees are per-knob.)
PRIMARY metric: network_sh_spectrum.csv ev1 must move off the wl1off 0.14135 plateau
by MUCH more than the 0.6% (-> 0.14220) that mw_wl.ewl_fold_rows bought on the DD
chord basis; below that the ordering risk is not worth it and the knob stays off.
SECONDARY: must not degrade clock_std_m / worst_dev_m / D5 churn.
TELEMETRY: the run-end 'Network (SD pre-reduce EWL)' line + logs/network_sd_ewl.csv.
